messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 5):
"""
After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract. 13 Your Obligations Please disclose all pre-existing disease/s or condition/s before buying a policy. Non-disclosure may affect the claim settlement. Disclosure of other material information during the policy period.) Insurer to specify the material information Declaration by the Policy Holder; I have read the above and confirm having noted the details. Place: Date: (Signature of the Policyholder) Note: i. Insurer shall provide web-link where the product related documents including the Customer Information sheet are available on the website of the insurer. ii. In case of any conflict, the terms and conditions mentioned in the policy document shall prevail. iii. Insurer to take confirmation of the policyholder regarding receiving of the Customer Information Sheet.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What happens if a policyholder fails to disclose a pre‑existing disease before purchasing a health insurance policy?","answer":"Non‑disclosure may affect the claim settlement.","facts":["Please disclose all pre-existing disease/s or condition/s before buying a policy.","Non-disclosure may affect the claim settlement."]},{"question":"After the moratorium period, can a health insurance policy be contested for reasons other than fraud or permanent exclusions?","answer":"No, it cannot be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract.","facts":["After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract."]}]}
